source.title: ...and that note you found
source.description:
The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.
Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.
"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
source.objective: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
source.completion: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
